WITH bnkm AS (
SELECT CustomerAccountId, PeriodEndDate, AccumulatedCurrentBalance FROM bnkm.CasaTdAggregateBalance 
    WHERE PeriodEndDate = '2023-01-27' AND AggregateBalanceType = 'Year-to-Date Average Daily Balance'
    AND CustomerAccountId IN (
        SELECT FORACID FROM busc.DEP_GENERALACCOUNTMASTER WHERE isLatest = 1
    )
    ---AND CustomerAccountId IN (
    ---    SELECT FORACID FROM busc.DEP_GENERALACCOUNTMASTER WHERE isLatest = 1
    ---)
    ---AND CustomerAccountId NOT IN 
    ---('2f35e64a425413e75ddd3d894074c710'
    ---,'d60a14938684acce8d040bfbd781ec08'
    ---,'c88e3fd8131d967571e88fdd4ba1c250'
    ---,'8489f463eea8640137a43ecb2fe985e1') ---- ACIDs sharing the same FORACID; Records from 20230127 file are isLatest=1 while files from 20230501 are isLatest=0.
)
,busc AS
(
SELECT
BDG.FORACID AS CustomerAccountId
,'Year-to-Date Average Daily Balance' AS AggregateBalanceType
,BDT.CURRENT_EOD_DATE AS PeriodEndDate
,BDT.PREVIOUS_CURRBAL AS PreviousCurrentBalance
,BDT.PREVIOUS_CLEARBAL AS PreviousClearBalance
,BDT.ACCUMULATED_CURRBAL AS AccumulatedCurrentBalance
,BDT.ACCUMULATED_CLEARBAL AS AccumulatedClearBalance
,BDT.BANK_ID AS FinancialInstitutionId
,'DEP' AS SOURCESYSTEMCODE
,BDT.INSERT_DTTM AS INSERTDTTM
FROM  BUSC.DEP_YTDDEPAGGRBALANCES BDT 
LEFT JOIN  BUSC.DEP_GENERALACCOUNTMASTER BDG ON BDG.ACID = BDT.ACID AND BDG.ISLATEST = '1'
WHERE BDG.FORACID IS NOT NULL AND BDT.ISLATEST = '1'
)
---,exclude_FORACID AS (
---SELECT FORACID FROM 
---    (SELECT FORACID, COUNT(*) AS CNT FROM busc.DEP_GENERALACCOUNTMASTER 
---    WHERE isActive = 1 and DEL_FLG != 'Y' GROUP BY FORACID HAVING COUNT(*) > 1) A
---)
,exclude_FORACID AS (
SELECT FORACID FROM 
    (SELECT FORACID, COUNT(*) AS CNT 
    FROM (SELECT FORACID, ACID FROM busc.DEP_GENERALACCOUNTMASTER WHERE DEL_FLG != 'Y' GROUP BY FORACID, ACID) A
    GROUP BY FORACID HAVING COUNT(*) > 1) B
)
SELECT 
    SUM(ISNULL(A.AccumulatedCurrentBalance,0) - ISNULL(B.AccumulatedCurrentBalance,0))
    FROM bnkm A
    FULL OUTER JOIN busc B
    ON A.CustomerAccountId = B.CustomerAccountId
    WHERE A.CustomerAccountId NOT IN (SELECT * FROM exclude_FORACID)
    AND ((B.AccumulatedCurrentBalance IS NULL AND A.AccumulatedCurrentBalance IS NOT NULL) 
    OR (B.AccumulatedCurrentBalance IS NOT NULL AND A.AccumulatedCurrentBalance IS NULL)
    OR (A.AccumulatedCurrentBalance != B.AccumulatedCurrentBalance))


SELECT 
    SUM(AccumulatedCurrentBalance)
    FROM bnkm
    WHERE CustomerAccountId NOT IN (SELECT * FROM exclude_FORACID)
